summary: Comprehensive testing of German meal planner (Speiseplaner) side dishes bug fix. The bug where side dishes (Beilagen) disappeared after page reload has been FIXED. All backend API tests pass (8/8). Frontend Playwright tests confirm full flow works: adding side dishes, saving, and persistence after reload.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The side dishes bug has been fixed. The MealPlanner.jsx was rewritten with proper state management. Key components: SlotConfigDialog (for configuring meals with side dishes), SlotCell (for displaying meals in grid), and MealPlanner (main component). The API uses session cookies for auth. Test user exists with meals already configured for week 2026-03-23.
